overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board could omit the appealing officer's name from the notice because it reasonably anticipated an executive session under Purpose 1.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the notice for the Jan. 9, 2012 disciplinary appeal hearing failed to name the officer appealing his suspension.
allegations.key_passage: The fact that Sargent O'Donnell's attorney ultimately requested that the discussion be held in open session did not create a retroactive obligation to include his name in the meeting notice since, at the time the notice was created, the Board Chair did not reasonably anticipate having an open session discussion.
